reason: The one-page free look is fine, I would read it Monday morning with my coffee, and it costs me nothing. But paying $250 up front to a guy I met once, out of Roscoe, to touch my quotes and my missed-call log, that is not this month.
objection: No robot talks to my customers unless you approve every word, approve every word once, then what happens on the Tuesday I am on a job site and it improvises? A wrong quote or wrong promise to a customer costs me the job and my name, and $750 held back does not come close to covering that. Also a written test we agreed at the start is only as good as whoever wrote it, and that would be him.
would_change_my_mind: Two things together: a local reference I can actually call, another trades or dental office owner within an hour of Rockford who will tell me what it did and what it broke, and letting me pay the whole $950 only after I see it run for 30 days on my real missed-call log.
